Petition To Approve Compromise Of Claim (Minor)
Off Calendar Jan-29-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for a Hearing on a Minor's Compromise.
Department 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Jason A.J. Lundberg, Esq., and Igor Kopilenko, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff(s) Petitioner: Charles Sandvig, parent and Guardina ad Litem for minor Berit Sandvig.
Petitioner sworn and examinded.
After testimony and consideration of the evidence presented, the Petition is granted and compromise is approved as follows:
Total Settlement: $200,000.00
Attorney's Fees: $48,745.54
Reimbursement for medical and all other expenses paid by the petitioner of the petitioner's attorney in the total amount of: $13,149.63
Medical, Hospital, ambulance, nursing, and other like expenses payable directly to providers as follows; in the total amount of: $18,150.56 payable to Aetna Health Plan One Eden Parkway, La Grange, KY 40031-8100

A net balance of $119,954.27 The full amont available to Claimant shall be deposited into her existing 529 Plan Account. The account is presently held with Charles Schwab, 200 California Street, San Francisco, CA 94111. The court makes the following additional orders: Money shall be placed in a low risk profile 529 Plan Account.
Court signed Order Granting approval of Minor.
Status Hearing Scheduled on 4/23/20013 at 9:00 AM, in Department 514 for filing of receipt for the deposit of money into blocked account. No appearance is required if the receipt is filed and courtesy copy lodge with Depart. 514 prior to Hearing.
